📜 Criminal Justice & Policing
NC SB 355 — NC Could Let Tuition Waived for Fallen Heroes' Families

This bill allows tuition waivers for the children of law enforcement, corrections, and firefighter personnel who are permanently disabled or killed in the line of duty, and for spouses who are also permanently disabled.

July 7, 2026: Signed by Gov.
